author: reek
body: A file read on a target that has no filesystem. `read-file-raw` is a real builtin and reaches the plug builtin table, so the arm64 and riscv plugs must refuse to emit for it rather than answering the empty string.

author: reek
body: The subject of `build/cross-unsupported-test.ps1`. It carries a `.skip` because the default battery is x86-64, where this program is ordinary and proves nothing.
